purpose: Decode from sets of functional scalp regions; find which regions carry motor imagery and how small a region-based montage can be.
claim_boundary: Exploratory, planned after the main study's test results were known. Session-1 cross-validation numbers are test-free; session-2 numbers are not a prospective test and do not change the frozen final configuration.
primary: artifact-free session-2 trials (final part) or held-out session-1 runs (cv part)
